name: Oni Oneesan
source:
As the Oni horde grows stronger and stronger, it becomes clear that defending against their might is fruitless. Many of the powerful kingdoms have fallen, and the heir to a small merchant kingdom with hardly any soldiers to boast decides the only way to save his people is marrying one of the two most powerful bachelorettes in the known world - Princess Mai and Princess Tetsuko.

The Oni court approves, but with a small caveat - if the marriage is to go through, he'll have to rein in the bickering pair's worst excesses, as well as teach them about ruling properly in times of peace.

It can't be [i]too[/i] hard, can it?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
随着鬼部落变得越来越强大，很明显，防御他们的力量是徒劳的。许多强大的王国都已陷落，一个几乎没有任何士兵值得夸耀的小商业王国的继承人决定拯救他的人民的唯一方法是与已知世界上最强大的两个未婚女子之一 - 舞公主和哲子公主结婚。

奥尼法庭批准了，但有一个小小的警告——如果婚姻要顺利进行，他就必须控制这对争吵的夫妇最严重的过激行为，并教他们如何在和平时期正确裁决。

总不能是[i]too[/i]难吧？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219620/]Steam[/url]]
